title: Preparation of Lung Tissue Blocks for MPLEx
author: Brittney Gorman
materials: Rapid-Core Sampling Punch - 4 mm Ted Pella Inc. Catalog #15115-10

steps.title: Equilibrate Sample in Cryostat
steps.instruction: Place the sample in the cryostat and allow it to thermally equilibrate for approximately 20 to 30 minutes.

steps.title: Set Cryostat Temperatures
steps.instruction: Configure the cryostat temperature settings for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Set blade temperature to -16 °C and specimen temperature to -14 °C
Alternatively, set blade temperature to -18 °C and specimen temperature to -16 °C
Place sections in pre-weighed 2 mL Sorenson MµlTI™ SafeSeal™ Microcentrifuge Tubes (VWR International (Avantor) Catalog #53550)

steps.title: Punch Tissue Cores
steps.instruction: Extract tissue cores from the sections using a Rapid-Core Sampling Punch (4 mm, Ted Pella Inc. Catalog #15115-10).

substeps.instruction: Punch 2 tissue cores from each tissue section
Avoid regions containing OCT to prevent contamination in the mass spectrum
Place the punches in pre-weighed 2 mL Sorenson MµlTI™ SafeSeal™ Microcentrifuge Tubes (VWR International (Avantor) Catalog #53550)

steps.title: Weigh and Store Samples
steps.instruction: Weigh the samples and store them at -80 °C until MPLEx sample preparation.
